messages:
Alex: Quick postmortem scheduling for the SLO-regression incident earlier today. Want to lock attendees, agenda sections, and follow-up owners before I send the invite.
Priya: +1. Can we do 45m? There's a lot to cover but don't want to drag it. 45 works for me.
Devon: 45 is fine. Suggest tight agenda: timeline (10), root-cause brainstorm (20), actions (10), wrap (5).
Sasha: I can take notes and capture actions. Also propose an 'observability debt' follow-up item — we've been deferring it.
Maria: I'm oncall but can join the tail end if we run over. If we need infra deep-dive, maybe invite infra-sre separately.
Alex: Proposed attendee matrix:
- incident-owners: Devon, Priya
- oncall: Maria
- infra: infra-sre (optional deep-dive)
- product: Jen (context, optional)
- tooling: Leah (required for alert tuning)
Who else? Mark required vs optional.
Priya: Product optional. Jen optional.
Devon: Leah should be required, she has the alert context.
Sasha: I'll paste the runbook link here: <https://redwood.internal/incident/SLO-2026-03|runbook> and drop a short timeline before the meeting.
Alex: OK required: Devon, Priya, Leah, Sasha. Optional: Maria, Jen, infra-sre. I'll send the invite once we pick a slot.
Priya: Preferred slots (react with :one:, :two:, :three:): 1) today 15:30-16:15, 2) today 16:30-17:15, 3) tomorrow 10:00-10:45. Then react :thumbsup: to confirm.
Devon: :one:  
Sasha: :two: 
Maria: :three: (can only join tomorrow morning)
Leah: :two: 
Jen: :three: 
Alex: Poll so far — 15:30 (1), 16:30 (2), tomorrow 10 (2). 16:30 edges it.
Priya: If it's 16:30 I can join live. Devon? Leah?
Devon: I'll make 16:30 work.
Leah: 16:30 ok.
Alex: Creating invite for 16:30-17:15. Draft agenda:
1) 5m — quick overview & impact numbers (Devon)
2) 10m — timeline & alert review (Sasha)
3) 20m — root cause diagnosis + hypotheses (group)
4) 10m — concrete follow-ups and owners (Alex/Priya)
5) 10m — short mitigation/verification plan (Devon)
6) 5m — wrap & async follow-ups (Sasha)
Please flag missing items.
Sasha: Add a 'data needed' checklist so we know what to gather pre-meeting. I'll list queries.
Maria: Can someone export P95/P99 tokenized traces and add them to the doc? I can only join after 16:45.
Devon: I'll export traces and attach by 16:15.
Priya: I'll own the action tracker during the meeting and create GH issues for follow-ups.
Alex: Pre-meeting owners:
- traces export: Devon
- runbook timeline + summary: Sasha
- action-tracker template: Priya
- invite + meet link: Alex
If all good I'll send the invite in ~5.
Jen: Good for optional invite, thanks.
calendar-bot: Poll created: 16:30-17:15 chosen. Invite will be sent to required+optional list in 2 minutes.
Alex: Invite sent. Please accept if you can. I'll post the pre-read (timeline + traces link) in this thread when ready.
